title: Existence of solutions to the voltage-conductance kinetic equation in a general conductivity regime
summary: We establish the existence of a weak solution to the Voltage-Conductance kinetic equation for any conductivity parameter and any reasonable initial datum, and in particular without smallness condition as it was the case in [9]. The proof is based on some a priori estimates mainly drawn from [15], some trace results adapted from [14] and a DiPerna-Lions weak stability argument.
